== Notes ==
* The range for this skill is much shorter than the resurrection range of [[Comfort Animal]].
* As of the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20090806|August 6, 2009]] game update and [[Feedback:Game_updates/20090806|August 26, 2026]] game update, [[Comfort Animal]] or [[Comfort Animal (PvP)]] can be used instead of Charm Animal for your companion to travel with you. [[Heal as One]] was updated with the [[Feedback:Game_updates/20100225|February 25, 2010]] game update to also have this functionality in [[PvE]]. These updates largely render Revive Animal suboptimal because of their ability to resurrect pets, mandatory bar placement for pet usage, cast time, recharge time, pet heal and range.
